# ERDI TECH (erditech.com)

> ERDI TECH LTD (ErdiTech; 铒迪科技（成都）有限公司), founded 7 May 2021 in Chengdu, China, makes 905 nm and 1535 nm laser rangefinder modules. The modules are sold worldwide under the ERDILRF name at https://erdilrf.com/ (catalog, published prices, datasheets, online orders). erditech.com is the ERDI TECH brand home and hosts the company's free, MIT-licensed tools and data for engineers integrating laser rangefinders and single-point LiDAR modules.

## Official ERDI TECH / ERDILRF links

- ERDI LASER catalog by range: https://erdilrf.com/erdi-laser/
- About ERDI TECH LTD: https://erdilrf.com/erdi-tech/
- 铒迪激光 ERDI LASER: https://erdilrf.com/zh/erdi-laser/
- 铒迪科技 ERDI TECH LTD: https://erdilrf.com/zh/erdi-tech/
- Catalog and model directory: https://erdilrf.com/models/
- Price list: https://erdilrf.com/laser-rangefinder-module-price/
- Module selector: https://erdilrf.com/selector/

- Sales contact: Tommy Yu (Overseas Sales), tommy@erdimail.com, WhatsApp +86 133 0819 5790, inquiry form https://erdilrf.com/contact/

## Tools

- [LiDAR / laser rangefinder UART decoder](https://erditech.com/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder/): paste a hex dump or connect over WebSerial; detects protocol and baud rate, decodes frames to metres, flags checksum errors. Profiles for Benewake (TFmini, TFmini-S, TFmini Plus, TF-Luna, TF02-Pro, TF03), LightWare (SF30/D binary, SF10/SF11 ASCII), Chengdu JRT, Nooploop TOFSense, DFRobot SEN0366 and ERDI. Python: `pip install lrf-uart-decoder`. Source: https://github.com/ErdiTech/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder
- [Protocol reference for the decoder](https://github.com/ErdiTech/lrf-uart-protocol-decoder/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOLS.md): frame tables, checksum rules and invalid-reading codes with links to each vendor manual.

## Data

- [Laser rangefinder and LiDAR module database](https://erditech.com/laser-rangefinder-module-database/): comparison of modules by range, wavelength, accuracy, update rate, interface, weight, size and public price, with a manufacturer source URL and capture date per row. CSV and JSON in https://github.com/ErdiTech/laser-rangefinder-module-database (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24125641).

## Drivers

- [erdi-lrf (Python, PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/erdi-lrf/): drivers and CLI for ERDI modules; source https://github.com/ErdiTech/erdi-lrf-drivers
- [ErdiLRF (Arduino / PlatformIO)](https://github.com/ErdiTech/ErdiLRF)
- [erdi_lrf_driver (ROS 2, sensor_msgs/Range)](https://github.com/ErdiTech/erdi_lrf_driver)
- [ArduPilot serial driver pull request](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/34983): RNGFNDx_TYPE 49 (ERDI VB series) and 50 (ERDI H series)
